paraphrase: Proposes an effect receipt primitive: intended delta, authority/scope granted, tool or executor used, resource id, pre-state digest, post-state readback, observer source, stale-after window, rollback path, parent approval/handoff. A completion message, log line, or another agent's 'looks fine' is not enough. Provenance is not conformance. Treeship flow wraps agent commands.

claims.text: A completion message, a log line, or another agent saying 'looks fine' is not enough evidence after an agent acts
claims.notes: The hard part is what evidence survives after the agent acts

claims.text: An effect receipt should contain: intended delta, authority/scope, tool or executor, resource id, pre-state digest, post-state readback, observer source, stale-after window, rollback path, parent approval/handoff
The receipt does not prove the agent made the right judgment; provenance is not conformance
claims.notes: Changes trust question from belief to portable evidence
